 Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ 3 kids steal the show in adorable pumpkin patch photos 
 By 
 Vanessa Serna 
 Published 
 Oct. 29, 2026, 1:50 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Patrick and Brittany Mahomes took their three kids on an adorable pumpkin patch outing as they gear up for Halloween.
 The Kansas City Chiefs star and Brittany’s three kids, Sterling Skye, 5, Patrick “Bronze” Lavone, 3, and Golden Raye, 1, posed together on a hay stack via Instagram Story photos Wednesday.
 The trio appeared in good spirits as they beamed while holding mini pumpkins. 
 8 
 Patrick and Brittany Mahomes shared adorable photos of their three kids during a pumpkin patch outing. (Seen here L-R: Patrick “Bronze” Lavone, 3, Sterling Skye, 5, and Golden Raye, 1.) brittanylynne/instagram 
 8 
 The NFL star was seen smiling with his youngest kids. brittanylynne/instagram

 In a second photo, Bronze was seen eating a bag of Doritos while sitting with Golden and Patrick, 31, on a tram. 
 Another sweet snap showed Sterling smiling on a flamingo while riding the carousel, as the NFL pro held onto his youngest kids, who were sitting on separate animals nearby.
 In the last photo, Sterling stole the spotlight as she smiled with several bear statues.
 8 
 Bronze was seen munching on chips as they rode on a tram. brittanylynne/instagram 
 8 
 Sterling was seen posing on a carousel. brittanylynne/instagram 
 The family’s festive outing follows another pumpkin patch visit earlier this month.
 At the time, Brittany, 31, took to social media to celebrate the start of fall with several photos of her kids visiting Johnson Farms.
 The photos also showed the little ones participating in several fall festivities, including games and arts-and-crafts.

 Patrick held onto his youngest kids on the same ride. brittanylynne/instagram

 Brittany frequently gives her followers a glimpse into her family life, especially as they cheer on Patrick and the Kansas City Chiefs. 
 The Sports Illustrated model often dresses her kids in Chiefs red and takes them on the sidelines to watch the quarterback during games hosted at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri.
 Most recently, she shared a photo dump of her family of five at a recent game, with her kids sitting front and center to watch Patrick as he spoke at a press conference following the match.
 8 
 Brittany and Patrick (seen here with their kids) often share inside looks at family days. brittanylynne/instagram 
 8 
 The couple (seen above) tied the knot in 2022. brittanylynne/instagram 
 Brittany also recently showed off her arm tattoo in honor of her kids, featuring silhouettes of all three of them.
 The fine-line ink also includes their names with a date.
 Patrick and Brittany tied the knot in 2022 after they started dating as teenagers in high school a decade earlier.
